Americans need an HHS Secretary who actually understands our nation’s health system. Kennedy’s inexperience and ignorance of basic concepts make him wholly unqualified for the position. His dangerous and archaic demagoguery on vaccines and public health puts lives at risk.
https://t.co/BUXo7wLbWf

Head Start is a lifeline for over 800,000 children, providing high-quality early education, health, and nutrition services. These programs rely on timely funding to cover essential expenses like employee pay, rent, and utilities. Without federal funding, many centers could be forced to close, leaving thousands of children and families without access to vital childcare and education.

That’s why I joined @HouseDemocrats in demanding the Trump Administration immediately release these delayed Head Start funds. We must ensure these centers receive the support they need to stay open and continue giving children the foundation they need to thrive. Our children’s futures depend on it.

Over 386,000 women are serving our nation, and they deserve the freedom to make the best decisions for their bodies, their futures, and their families.

The Department of Defense’s decision to rescind travel reimbursements for reproductive health care is a direct and dangerous attack on the rights of America’s servicewomen. It’s unacceptable to deny any servicemember access to essential care while they put their lives on the line to defend our country.

I will continue to fight for the health care that all women need, including comprehensive reproductive health care and abortion access.

Over 9 million veterans rely on the VA for care, and President Trump's directive to end all diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility (DEIA) initiatives jeopardizes the health and well-being of these veterans. Health care providers know that understanding the unique needs of veterans from diverse backgrounds is key to improving health outcomes.

These actions are disgraceful, dangerous, and wholly unacceptable. I call on the President to stop putting veterans’ lives at risk in order to further extremist ideology and an extremist agenda.

The @DemWomenCaucus is standing strong and fighting back against the relentless attacks on women and families by the Trump administration and Elon Musk. These attacks on early childhood education, personal data, nutrition assistance, and access to health care and vital information are deeply personal — they affect real people, real families, every single day.

I am committed to ensuring that women and their families are protected from the erosion of their rights and safety, and I will continue to fight for them.

Today, the Senate confirmed RFK Jr. as the Secretary of Health and Human Services, elevating a dangerous conspiracy theorist to one of the nation’s most critical posts for public health and safety.
 
Despite being confronted with irrefutable evidence of RFK Jr.’s anti-vaccine activism, his complete lack of knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid, and self-contradicting and anti-science policy agenda, an overwhelming majority of Republican Senators decided to put their loyalty to President Trump over their duty to protect the interests of the American people.
 
While I am deeply disappointed by the Senate’s latest confirmation of yet another unqualified and unserious candidate for a position in the executive branch, I will not stop fighting against right-wing extremism and I will continue working to curb any agenda that derails our public health, safety, and well-being.
https://t.co/Hy0mKlHWh8

Last night, House Republicans sold out the American people. By voting for the largest Medicaid cut in our nation’s history, over 200,000 people on Medicaid in our district are now at risk of losing their health care. House Republicans voted to raise health care premiums by almost $3,000/year for the 38,000 people in our district who receive coverage under the Affordable Care Act. House Republicans also voted to slash food and nutrition assistance funding for 35,000 people in our district.

This reckless Republican budget is an outright betrayal of the American people,  and I will continue to fight alongside @HouseDemocrats to protect the quality of life of America’s working families.

The Trump Administration’s reckless plan to fire 83,000 VA employees is a direct attack on our veterans and their care. Trump’s dangerous directive puts the health and well-being of our nation’s heroes at risk – a blatant betrayal of the promises made to those who served.

Spearheaded by Elon Musk, this shameful action is nothing less than an attempt to dismantle the VA, jeopardizing critical services our veterans rely on. @HouseDemocrats will not stand by while veterans pay the price for this outrageous and disrespectful plan.

Our veterans deserve leaders who honor their service and stand by them – not betray and abandon them for political gain. I will never stop fighting to ensure the VA fulfills its mission to care for those who served our nation in uniform.
https://t.co/7snYVT26l7

Donald Trump and Republicans are ramming through the largest Medicaid cut in history – nearly $1 trillion – to bankroll tax breaks for billionaires like Elon Musk and their corporate cronies.

This Republican scheme will rip health care away from tens of millions, drive up costs for millions more, and dismantle Medicaid for the 80 million Americans who rely on it – including over 204,000 people across #VenturaCounty and the Conejo Valley. Instead of making the wealthy pay their fair share, Republicans are shifting the burden of this egregious tax giveaway onto working families.

Every American deserves affordable, quality health care. That’s why I will never stop fighting to protect Medicaid.

The Trump Administration’s plan to cut over 80,000 employees at the Department of Veterans Affairs, in addition to the 2,400 VA employees who have already been terminated, is an alarming move that threatens the health and well-being of our nation’s veterans. These firings are a clear indication that this administration is not prioritizing the needs of the men and women who have bravely served our nation in uniform and is actively undermining the quality of care they receive.

Our commitment to our veterans should never be used as a bargaining chip to advance political agendas. Supporting the men and women who have served our nation must transcend partisan ideology because supporting veterans is always the right thing to do. We must do everything in our power to serve them as well as they have served us.

The Trump Administration recklessly slashed over $12 billion from public health programs that track infectious diseases, expand mental health care, and provide addiction treatment.

But that’s not all. Now, they want to gut 20,000 jobs at the Department of Health & Human Services—not political appointees, but doctors, scientists, and experts who:

✅ Protect our food
✅ Monitor deadly diseases
✅ Approve life-saving medications
✅ Oversee health insurance for nearly half the country

This isn’t just a budget cut – it’s a direct attack on public health that will put lives at risk.

https://t.co/m56BgUg48Z

On #WorldHealthDay, we must continue to sound the alarm on the Trump administration’s deadly assault on public health – here at home and around the world.

Recently, Trump and RFK Jr. unlawfully fired 20,000 public servants at the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services and stripped away core functions Americans rely on like ensuring the safety of medications and medical products, delivering essential health care services, and advancing life-saving research.

Just days ago, scientists at the NIH announced a major breakthrough in cancer treatment. But instead of building on that progress, Trump’s anti-science agenda is blocking it. These cuts aren’t just bureaucratic – they’re dangerous. This administration is crippling our response to public health threats, weakening the CDC, CMS, FDA, and more, and unraveling the infrastructure we need in a crisis.

Discarding science, silencing experts, and dismantling HHS puts millions at risk. We must reverse course, restore our nation’s commitment to high-quality, accessible care, and reengage with the global institutions working to protect the health of all people.
https://t.co/SZVdcCU0Ac

President Trump’s blanket return-to-office mandate is a dangerous decision that’s disrupting care, driving out providers, and creating chaos across the VA. VA workers are being crammed into closets, stripped of remote tools that expanded mental health care, and pushed out altogether. The mandate is also making it harder to recruit and retain the skilled professionals our veterans rely on – and it’s putting veterans' care and benefits at serious risk.

I am demanding immediate answers from Secretary Collins. Our nation’s veterans deserve better. This reckless mandate must be fixed now.

As the Trump administration continues to target critical healthcare programs, including Medicaid and Medicare, I have been meeting with local healthcare providers and stakeholders across the district to hear their concerns.

I recently met with Gold Coast Health Plan’s new Acting CEO, Dr. Feliz L. Nuñez, who provided an overview of the many vital services the organization provides to deliver high-quality, cost-effective, and culturally competent care to our community. As a County Organized Health System, Gold Coast Health Plan programs are uniquely tailored to meet the needs of over 240,000 #VenturaCounty residents, making their work especially critical to our community’s health and well-being.

I recently visited the Goebel Adult Community Center in Thousand Oaks, a place where seniors come together to enrich their daily lives through a wide range of programs and services. From social activities to health support, Goebel plays a vital role in keeping our seniors active, engaged, and connected to their community.

But right now, these essential programs are under attack. Republicans are pushing reckless budget cuts to Medicaid and Social Security — two lifelines millions of seniors rely on for their health, well-being, and security. And as if that wasn’t enough, the Trump administration is working to dismantle the Administration for Community Living, which helps protect seniors from abuse, ensures they can access the benefits they’ve earned, and supports crucial services like adult day care centers and programs for seniors facing food insecurity.

During my visit, I spoke with seniors whose lives would be directly impacted by these cuts. The center’s adult day health services are a lifeline for many, and their stories made one thing clear: these programs are absolutely essential to the quality of life for our seniors.

I will continue to fight back against Republicans’ efforts to gut these programs and dismantle the safety net millions of Americans rely on. I will stand with our seniors and their families because they deserve better. I will protect Medicaid, Social Security, and the services that allow our seniors to live with dignity.

President Trump’s budget doesn’t just make devastating cuts – it cuts people out of the promise of America.

It tears teachers and resources out of classrooms, medicine out of clinics, meals off the tables of kids and seniors, and housing away from families struggling to stay afloat – all to bankroll a government that protects the powerful and punishes everyone else.

This budget turns its back on our core values, from scientific progress and innovation to the right to an education and access to healthcare. It abandons the fundamental belief that government should work for the people, not against them.

This budget is a betrayal of the American people, and I’ll keep fighting to make sure it never becomes reality.
https://t.co/QAWyXmBwyu

Republicans have launched one of the most egregious attacks on our public lands, our waters, and our health that we have ever witnessed.

It hands over our national parks, forests, and precious natural resources to oil and gas corporations, putting their profits over the safety and well-being of the American people. In exchange for giveaways to the wealthiest polluters, American families will face higher energy costs, dirtier air and water, and more frequent environmental disasters.

This is the same 'polluters over people' agenda that has defined the Trump Administration, where corporate greed comes first and the American people pay the price. This Republican proposal will add billions to the deficit while selling off our environment, our economy, and our future to the highest bidder.

This bill is shameful, and the American people deserve better.

In the United States, 1 in 5 adults experience mental health challenges. That’s why we must recommit to ending the stigma and raising awareness about the resources available to those who are struggling.

The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline is available 24/7 by call, text, or chat at https://t.co/O9B106Bqwv. Remember: You are not alone, and it’s always okay to ask for help.

Together, we can turn struggle into strength, silence into change, and stories into hope. #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth

During #NationalPoliceWeek, law enforcement officers from across the country descend on Washington, DC to honor the fallen and recognize the service of our nation’s heroes. Alongside them, first responders, including paramedics, nurses, and medical personnel, provide critical on-the-ground support for the week’s ceremonies and events.

This year, #VenturaCounty’s own Dave Conahey, a dedicated nurse and National Disaster Medical System (NDMS) responder from #Moorpark, was among them. Dave has deployed across the country to support communities and health systems in the wake of disasters, answering the call wherever and whenever he’s needed.

Earlier this week, I had the opportunity to meet with Dave and other first responders who work tirelessly behind the scenes to support our law enforcement officers and help our nation in times of crisis.

As the House Rules Committee enters its 17th hour of considering one of the largest Republican rip-offs and redistributions of wealth, House Republicans are pushing a dangerous bill that would strip health care from nearly 14 million Americans and slash $300 billion from food assistance programs that 42 million people rely on – all to pay for tax breaks for billionaires. They called the meeting at 1:00 AM, hoping the American people wouldn’t notice.

But @HouseDemocrats are still here. We’ve filed 537 amendments to defend the programs working families depend on. We’re fighting back, and we are not backing down.

https://t.co/MvVKJNMExy
